assessments.reasoning: The DEC-08-AJAB-D title page names FOCAL and the machine family. The copyright page gives DEC and 1968. Chapter 1 on printed p. 1-1 discusses FOCAL as an online conversational service for numerical problems on the PDP-8 family and expressly names and describes the FOCAL language through its imperative statements and mathematical notation.

challenge.method: Compared both senses of FOCAL in the opening paragraph with the loading procedure, with the CHM-linked technical context from 1968, and with the January 1970 preface.
challenge.results: The same name can refer to the language or the conversational service in DEC material. The chapter explicitly identifies a command language, and the later preface identifies its FOCAL-8 implementation more narrowly. These uses support the historical language identity at the specified edition.

limitations: The stated date uses the copyright year. The claim tracks the 1968 language account and leaves other machines, ports, and later variants to separately scoped evidence. Active is the registry state.
